# Installation

Install [Combodo Data Collector Base](https://store.itophub.io/en_US/products/itop-data-collector-base) outside the web root. Extract the release ZIP and copy the contents of `collectors/` into the Base installation's `collectors/` directory. Copy `VERSION` into `collectors/VERSION` and configure `IONOS_TOKEN` in the process environment or in a private `.env` file at the Base root.
